description: This Java source file defines an Activity called PrintHtmlOffScreen that demonstrates printing off-screen HTML content rendered in a WebView. It loads an HTML file, triggers print through the Android print framework, and manages WebView lifecycle during printing.

classes.name: PrintHtmlOffScreen
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates off-screen HTML printing using WebView and PrintManager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu which includes the print option.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, triggers printing when the print menu item is selected.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Creates a WebView, loads HTML content, and sets up a callback to initiate printing once the page is loaded.

methods.name: doPrint
methods.description: Sets up the Android print framework to print the content loaded in WebView, and destroys the WebView after printing.
